name: Toasting glasses
summary: Two tall champagne flutes of bubbly clinking at an angle with a small splash; for toasts and celebrations. Anim clink.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x between the two feet

params.name: y
params.note: y of the feet (the glasses stand on y)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the pair is about 560 px wide and 600 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: clink = the glasses knock together and the splash flashes; sparkle = bubbles keep rising

author: krakujs
